chart.name: Selects/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('mysql.commands', filter=filter('command', 'select'), rollup='rate').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).min().publish(label='B')
C = (A).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='C')
D = (A).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='D')
E = (A).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='E')
F = (A).max().publish(label='F')

chart.name: Mutations/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('mysql.commands', filter=filter('command', 'insert'), rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('mysql.commands', filter=filter('command', 'update'), rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = data('mysql.commands', filter=filter('command', 'update_multi'), rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = data('mysql.commands', filter=filter('command', 'delete'), rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = (A+B+C+D).publish(label='E', enable=False)
F = (E).min().publish(label='F')
G = (E).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='G')
H = (E).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='H')
I = (E).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='I')
J = (E).max().publish(label='J')
